verdict_msg: Paley Type-I Hadamard (p=1019, D=1020) sub-block (M=510, N=1020) is a PERFECT ISOMETRY: all M singular values equal (rows mutually orthogonal). Empirical spectrum is a delta function; kappa_1 ~ 1.000, kappa_n ~ 0 for n>=2. This is the deterministic OPPOSITE of MP (which is full bulk). Implication for BBMD: Paley sub-blocks are TOO structured -- they collapse the spectrum entirely, not deviate from MP within a bulk. Recommendation: a Paley codebook in the Anchor-2 battery would test a DIFFERENT axis (isometric vs spread spectrum) than Kerdock's algebraic-bulk deviation. Include only if BBMD-distance is generalized to handle delta-spectra; otherwise SKIP.
